english.meaning: to hear it said; used to pass on hearsay
english.note: Introduces something heard secondhand, like I heard that.

exampleSentences.english: Kam-wai, I heard the news said an examiner cheated to help his son or daughter?
exampleSentences.traditional: 吖錦威，聽聞呢好似話，新聞話呢，誒有個考官呢，誒佢作弊喎，幫佢嘅仔定女話？
